    Diamond: the exceptional case and the conclusion #

    In the exceptional case τ ≫ f ≠ 0 (f the first arrow of ω' = f f'):

    • mex1: η is an arrow ([mild] figure 4.8, second diagram, completed);
    • mex2: f is the only arrow into its target ([mild] figure 4.9, second diagram; its conditions reduce to: μ ≫ φ = τ ≫ f forces φ = f);
    • P_x is projective-injective with socle τ ≫ f. no_projInj: a diamond gives a projective-injective P_x in P or in Pᵒᵖ.
